name: Sign in and create a thesis workspace
covers: restore last active workspace after refresh
description: Verifies a signed-in researcher can create a workspace and see its saved thesis settings.
steps: Sign in using the sign-in button
Create a workspace with a title and institution
Open the workspace dashboard
Refresh the page while still signed in
Verify the previously created workspace opens automatically
Create a second workspace from the active workspace
Switch between the two workspaces using the selector
Refresh and verify the selected workspace is restored
Schedule a research meeting with a date and time
Confirm its date and time appear on the dashboard calendar
Transfer ownership to another workspace member and confirm the new owner is shown
expected: Workspaces and members remain accessible; scheduled meetings appear on the dashboard calendar and ownership transfers only to an existing workspace member.

name: Edit and retain thesis proposal sections
description: Verifies editing a proposal section persists after navigating away and returning.
steps: Open the thesis document
Edit the Introduction section
Save changes and navigate to the dashboard
Reopen the Introduction section
Drag a section above another section and wait for the saved confirmation
Export the document as a DOCX file
Assign sections to Chapter 1 and Chapter 2
Select Chapter 1 and export the document
Upload a sample DOCX and review detected headings before importing
Open a section and review its creator, last editor, and modification time
Create a custom section, save it, and verify creator attribution is shown
expected: The export contains only the selected chapter's sections, and the sample DOCX import previews detected headings and assigns them to chapters before adding sections. Each section shows its recorded creator and last editor; new sections can be added and saved with attribution.

name: Create and update tasks with validation
description: Verifies owners can create tasks and assign deadlines while members can view tasks and update status without creating tasks or deadlines.
steps: Actor A signs in as workspace owner and creates a task with a due date
Actor B signs in as a member and verifies the task and deadline are visible
Actor B checks that task creation is owner-only
Actor A marks the task In progress and checks the dashboard deadline list
Refresh and reopen Tasks
Check the dashboard Team presence panel and verify each team member has an online or offline label.
expected: Only the owner can create tasks or set/change deadlines. Members can see the shared task and update status; task deadlines persist after refresh.

name: Chat with group members and retain messages
description: Verifies workspace members can send messages and see each other's saved messages.
steps: Actor A creates a workspace and shares its join code
Actor B signs in and joins that workspace
Actor A opens Chat and sends a message
Actor B opens Chat or refreshes messages
Choose Literature Review as the topic and send a message
Filter by Literature Review and search for a keyword
Verify the chat rail lists research topics only
Switch topics and confirm the selected topic is prominent in the chat header
Confirm notifications remain in the global notification center, not the chat rail
Verify messages show a circular profile photo or initials beside the sender
Open the emoji picker, search for an emoji, and insert it into a message
Verify presence indicators appear beside online members
expected: Messages retain their topic, members can filter/search research discussions, and messages persist across refresh. Chat rail contains topics only; selected topic is prominent and notifications remain global. Message rows show member avatars, and the emoji picker supports the full searchable emoji catalogue.

name: Join a workspace and read shared research content
covers: joining member sees shared sections and meetings
members view meetings in read-only mode
description: Verifies a second member can join by code and access the workspace's shared proposal sections.
steps: Actor A creates a workspace and adds a proposal section
Actor B signs in and joins using Actor A's code
Actor B opens the document workspace
Join an existing workspace from a second account and open Document
Actor A (owner / leader) creates a meeting with a custom agenda; Actor B verifies they can view but not edit or create meetings
Send a chat message and confirm the other member receives a notification
Choose a topic from the right-hand list and insert an emoji
As a non-owner, leave a workspace and verify it disappears from the workspace selector
As the owner, confirm workspace deletion and verify associated content is removed
After leaving the last workspace, verify create/join forms are available
expected: Joining members see the same workspace content; only the owner / leader can schedule, edit agendas or notes, or delete meetings; custom agendas persist; other members receive notifications; chat topics are visible on the right and the full emoji picker is available. Non-owners can leave, only owners can delete workspaces, and an empty-workspace page supports creating or joining another workspace.
